documentation.content: Runbook row: Job failure and missed schedule (MONITORING-RUNBOOK.md, Current-service signal plan; coordinated with RECOVERY-RETENTION.md's c369 alerting requirement). Responder: on-call API responder. Two independent conditions under OR: (1) any non-succeeded chirp-purge execution in a 5-minute window; (2) no completed_execution_count data point for 86400s, matching the committed Cloud Scheduler cadence in infra/monitoring/evidence/c398-scheduler-chirp-purge-daily-2026-09-10.json (schedule '0 9 * * *' UTC, daily, so cadence is exactly 24h). MetricAbsence.duration's live REST reference (docs.cloud.google.com/monitoring/api/ref_v3/rest/v3/projects.alertPolicies#MetricAbsence) states only a 120-second minimum and a must-be-a-multiple-of-60-seconds constraint; no maximum is documented there. With no verified upper bound, this ships exactly the cadence with no additional grace rather than guessing a larger value that might be rejected. The 5-minute evaluation window on condition (1) is a judgment call, not a runbook-stated number. Initial, review after 7 days.

conditionThreshold.filter: resource.type="cloud_run_job" AND resource.labels.project_id="{{PROJECT}}" AND resource.labels.job_name="chirp-purge" AND metric.type="run.googleapis.com/job/completed_execution_count" AND metric.labels.result!="succeeded"

conditionAbsent.filter: resource.type="cloud_run_job" AND resource.labels.project_id="{{PROJECT}}" AND resource.labels.job_name="chirp-purge" AND metric.type="run.googleapis.com/job/completed_execution_count"
